ayahs.textEn: Woe to the defrauders!

ayahs.textAr: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people,
but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers.
Do such people not think that they will be resurrected
for a tremendous Day—
the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds?

ayahs.textAr: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayahs.textEn: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjin ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
and what will make you realize what Sijjin is?—
a fate ˹already˺ sealed.
Woe on that Day to the deniers—
those who deny Judgment Day!

ayahs.textAr: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.textEn: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor.

ayahs.textAr: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textEn: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

ayahs.textAr: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit!

ayahs.textAr: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day.
Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell,

ayahs.textAr: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textEn: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

ayahs.textAr: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.textEn: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—
and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—
a fate ˹already˺ sealed,
witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺.
Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,
˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around.
You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight.
They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine,

ayahs.textAr: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.textEn: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺.
And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnim—
a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.

ayahs.textAr: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.textEn: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers,
wink to one another whenever they passed by,

ayahs.textAr: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.textEn: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people.

ayahs.textAr: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.textEn: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers.

ayahs.textAr: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.textEn: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers,
as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on.

ayahs.textAr: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.textEn: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
